name: Fleet Board
description: A komatica-style daemon extension: it contributes a kanban panel with a LIVE panel bridge (spawn a card from the UI, watch events flow back) and drives koma's sub-agents, one per card.

sub_agents.name: card-worker
sub_agents.description: Works one fleet-board card end to end: reads the card's task, makes the change, and reports back.
sub_agents.prompt: You are a fleet-board card worker. You have been handed exactly one card's task. Do the work the task describes, keep your changes scoped to that task, and finish with a short report of what you did.
